title: 03 AI Chat
subtitle: Using the AI chat panel, and several AI chats at once — Alligators brand
brief: Jak pouzivat AI chat a edge cases kdy pojede nekolik sessions zaraz — and: aby se uzivatel citil, ze muze pouzit ACP panel v nejakem jednoduchem modu a aby tak nejak vse pusobilo ze funguje proste autonomne. Simple by default; every ACP capability stays reachable under the panel's Advanced or ⌘K.

artboards.label: 1 · Two AIs, two artboards — the finish lands in place
artboards.note: Your AI finishes on Post 1:1 — solid spark ring, a before → after wipe — while Tereza's AI keeps translating the poster beside it. The prompt now has a paperclip: a photo, a folder (48 files, asks once) and a PDF sit inside it.

artboards.label: 2 · ⌘/ opens the AI chat panel
artboards.note: The selection arrives as a chip; up to three suggestions come from what you're doing (Tereza's 3 open comments) with a one-line why.

artboards.label: 3 · Suggestions follow what you were doing
artboards.note: Four contexts side by side — open comments, selected clips, a canvas just shared, your last ask about colour — each leads with one contextual chip and says why. Max 3 chips, one line each.

artboards.label: 4 · The chip says what AI touches
artboards.note: Folded spark, one artboard, whole canvas, 3 artboards — the chip is the scope and can be changed before sending.

artboards.label: 5 · AI works where you can see it
artboards.note: Dashed spark outline + tag on the artboard; the panel says the same words with Stop; you keep working elsewhere.

artboards.label: 6 · Done — the finish, then Undo or Keep going
artboards.note: The outline closes into a solid ring and a wipe passes before → after, then settles into Made by AI. Undo first, then Keep going.

artboards.label: 7 · Drop a photo or footage in
artboards.note: Drag files onto the panel or paste; photos, footage and PDFs land inside the prompt as chips and in Assets too.

artboards.label: 8 · The paperclip — files, a folder, Assets, a screenshot
artboards.note: The paperclip menu (Attach files… · Choose a folder… · From Assets · Paste a screenshot ⌘V · or drag here), what each chip shows, and the one-time folder consent.

artboards.label: 9 · A question — the canvas stays put
artboards.note: Text answer that says the canvas didn't change; a small spark ring points at the 9 pt date line; the fix is offered as a chip.

artboards.label: 10 · A long chat — full height, resizable, scrolled up
artboards.note: A long conversation in the tall panel: full window height, 420 wide, left edge drags wider; photos, a PDF and a folder in the turns, a before → after result, folded steps, Jump to latest, a three-line prompt.

artboards.label: 11 · Pinned to the side — a full-height column
artboards.note: Pin to the side in the panel header docks the AI chat panel as a full-height column; the canvas makes room. Same as View › Advanced › Pin panels to the side, for this panel only.

artboards.label: 12 · Two chats, two artboards
artboards.note: Each running chat has its artboard, outline and tag; the compact count next to the title lists them.

artboards.label: 13 · Same artboard — the second one waits
artboards.note: One AI per artboard: the second ask waits and starts by itself on top of the result; Run on a copy is the one verb, × cancels.

artboards.label: 14 · Run on a copy — both versions, side by side
artboards.note: The copy lands beside the original, started from before the busy chat; Keep the copy replaces the original (kept in Version history), Undo removes the copy.

artboards.label: 15 · The rule, drawn once
artboards.note: Lanes per artboard: parallel across artboards, a line on one artboard, whole-canvas asks take artboards as they free up, copies skip the line.

artboards.label: 16 · Running in another project tab
artboards.note: The other project's tab carries a spark that breathes (still under reduced motion); a toast with Show says when a chat there finishes.

artboards.label: 17 · Tereza's AI on the same canvas
artboards.note: Her AI wears the same spark outline and tag as yours, led by her avatar; listed under On this canvas, view only.

artboards.label: 18 · 41 chats — Running, then Earlier
artboards.note: Running first, then Earlier grouped by canvas; search finds words inside chats; row menu keeps Rename, Copy transcript, Archive, Move to trash.

artboards.label: 19 · Panel hidden — AI keeps going
artboards.note: Hiding the panel never stops AI; the spark carries a dot and a toast says when each chat is done.

artboards.label: 20 · Quitting mid-run
artboards.note: Quit asks once and says what stops; next launch the chat offers Undo or Keep going.

artboards.label: 21 · Needs you — panel hidden, another canvas
artboards.note: Folded spark turns azure with a count, the Uniformy-2027 row says Needs you, one toast offers Open; the count stays until answered.

artboards.label: 22 · Needs you — in another project tab
artboards.note: The tab's spark becomes an azure question mark; one toast with Open switches tabs and opens the question.

artboards.label: 23 · Needs you — the app in the background
artboards.note: A Mac notification and a Dock count, the same pair a mention gets (10 · co-mention-notify); the same azure mark on every surface; the ring legend; the screen-reader rule.

artboards.label: 24 · Asks before replacing your work
artboards.note: Where Open lands: the question open, an azure ring around the 4 photo artboards; Replace 4 photos / Not now. Restyling never asks.

artboards.label: 25 · A question back, and a failure
artboards.note: Choices with a way to type your own; a failure says what happened, that nothing changed, and Pick another clip.

artboards.label: 26 · Not connected · offline · setting up · used up · almost used up
artboards.note: CONTRACT §7: not connected — the one Connect sheet at the first send; offline — “Queued — sends when this Mac is online.” and “AI is back when this Mac is online.”; setting up, used up and almost used up keep the prompt.

artboards.label: 27 · Advanced — everything that used to be visible
artboards.note: Model, modes, tools, suggestions, readable folders, media providers, the raw log, slash commands and the session — all under the panel's Advanced; ⌘K finds each by name.

artboards.label: 28 · Modes, slash, paste, Copy and Retry, the terminal
artboards.note: The full Ask before list mapped to the agent's modes, the suggest-only banner, / in the simple field, pasted screenshots, per-message Copy and Retry, the terminal hand-off both ways.

artboards.label: 29 · Made by AI, in Version history
artboards.note: Every AI change is a version with Made by AI; compare side by side; Restore or Undo this chat.
